basis: Canonical V14 record_outcome stores outcome_hash = hash(actual verified effect evidence).
Historical V17.2 explicitly bound outcome evidence/provider evidence into prediction-outcome causal support.
Same-effect + same-cycle prediction/causal rows alone do not prove that causal credit explains the exact verified V14 effect outcome.
new_discriminating_finding.claim: A V17 terminal support chain must bind causal credit to the exact effect_id + attempt_id + verified V14 outcome_hash, not merely to another verified prediction outcome concerning the same effect.

semantics: Immutable pre-terminal support receipt binds effect_id, attempt_id, verified_outcome_hash, prediction_outcome_id and causal_id.
Prediction-outcome evidence must carry exact effect_id, attempt_id and effect_outcome_hash.
Runtime and storage guard require that immutable receipt in the same GWT/prediction/causal chain.
Mutation of prediction-outcome evidence away from the V14 outcome hash invalidates re-entry/DONE/recovery support.
CORRELATED_ONLY remains rejected at causal-support and semantic-delta-admission boundaries.
Explicit no-learning waives semantic delta only.
